header: Onboarding leads on their first quarter
subheadline: Teams switch to Brightpath to stop losing weeks between contract and go-live. After three months, time to go-live is the number they mention most.
quote: In our first quarter on Brightpath, median go-live fell from 38 days to 16. I no longer spend Mondays working out where each account stands.
author_role: Head of Customer Onboarding, Northwind Co.
